    def test_caller_cancellation_propagates():
        effects = []
        class Adapter:
            async def respond(self, context, tools):
                try:
                    await asyncio.sleep(10)
                finally:
                    effects.append("cleanup")

            task.cancel()
            with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task
